name: kinnect
description: Real-time GPS location tracking with rooms, contacts, SOS, geofencing, and live sharing

scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && go build -o server . && ./server
scripts.dev:be: cd backend && if [ -f ../.env ]; then set -a; . ../.env; set +a; fi; PORT=${PORT:-3001} go run .
scripts.build:android: cd frontend && VITE_TARGET=capacitor VITE_REALTIME_PROTOCOL=ws npx vite build && npx cap sync android
scripts.run:android: cd frontend && npx cap run android
scripts.build:ios: cd frontend && VITE_TARGET=capacitor VITE_REALTIME_PROTOCOL=ws npx vite build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.run:ios: cd frontend && npx cap run ios
